title: Northgate Tire Center Loyalty Recognition — Flat Repair Rates by Membership Years
content:
# Flat repair rates by membership years

**Schedule.** A Northgate Tire Center flat repair charge carries a member rate read from the count of membership fee charges on the Northgate Memberships ledger of the membership whose card was presented on the tires' purchase:

| Membership fee charges on that membership | Member rate |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 0.8 |
| at least 3 and fewer than 6 | 0.9 |
| fewer than 3 | 1 — the full rate |

## Reading the schedule

- **Which membership.** The purchase on which the tires were bought names the membership whose card was presented; only that membership's fee ledger is counted.
- **What is counted.** Each membership fee charge entry on that ledger counts once.
- **How the rate acts.** The flat repair charge is multiplied by the member rate. The rate acts on the unrounded charge, and the charge is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

| Fee charges | Rate |
|---|---|
| 2 | 1 |
| 3 | 0.9 |
| 5 | 0.9 |
| 6 | 0.8 |

A flat repair charge of $15.00 before this rate becomes $13.50 at 0.9 and $12.00 at 0.8.
